title: The Day the Barbers Cut the Wind
description: On the barbers’ spring holiday, the sea breeze is first in the chair. Its clipped curls scatter across the shop floor before anyone can sweep them up.
alt: An elderly barber snips a translucent ribbon of wind above an empty red chair in a stone shop overlooking blue water and white sea cliffs.
pairing: A spring barbers’ holiday × a haircut for the sea breeze
